translations.description_clean:
Updated for version 3.4 +

The primary human race are using the old portraits from before 3.4 as base and have 70 portraits that replace the standard ones.

The secondary human race is using the new human portraits and have 30 portraits replacing the standard ones.

Put this mod after the clothing mods in the modlist.

They use the standard animations and alpha mask from the original portraits so they should be compatible with clothing and hair mods as long as they don't change or replace the characters.

This mod only changes the characters face and body and does not add any clothing and/or hair.

The mod is achievements compatible as well as save game compatible.

The mod shouldn't change the version number of the game so it should work with multiplayer without everyone needing the mod. 

If you want cyborgs with your humans you might want this version: 
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1635059883] Remastered Human Portraits Expanded 

If you are looking for the remastered elves they can be found here: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1916470865] Remastered Elves

The version for the new human portraits can be found here:[url= https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2808669452] Remastered NEW Human Portraits

There is also a version of the mod that combines the new and old Remastered portraits mods for a total of 100 portraits: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2809217587] Remastered Human Portraits COMBINED

translations.description_clean:
I like the Real Galaxy very much, but there are still some flaws with this mod. Stellaris does not support image larger than 4K for particle FX, then when you put your camera too close to the galaxy plane, you will see rough pixels.
So I made some improvements in this mod:

Adjust the 4K Galaxy map to 8K to give more details when zooming in.
Remade the stars maps, reducing the size of each star, and improve the total resolution. So you can see the spherical shape instead of a huge pixel mass when zooming in.

Compatibility:
Mods changed galaxy size may not compatible, for this mod lock galaxy size for all vanilla setting. This means a 200 stars galaxy will be as large as a 1000 stars galaxy.

Also work with
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1918281610]Real Space - Colour Out of Deep
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=2409209888]Immersive Beautiful Stellaris
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2407436476]Immersive Beautiful Universe


Another Version
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2897254807]blue tone

Sorting:
No sorting requirements, you can put it anywhere.

translations.summary_zh_current: 将银河地图升级到 8K 纹理、重做恒星贴图，修复原版缩放时的像素模糊。
translations.description_zh_current: 作者很喜欢 Real Galaxy 但认为它存在缺陷：群星粒子特效不支持 4K 以上图片，镜头靠近银河平面时会看到粗糙像素。本模组的改进：① 将 4K 银河地图升级为 8K，放大时细节更丰富；② 重做恒星贴图，缩小每颗恒星的尺寸。

translations.reviews_zh_current: 订阅 4.7 万、收藏 2911。作者表示很喜欢 Real Galaxy，但认为该模组存在一些缺陷，例如 Stellaris 不支持超过 4K 的粒子特效图像，镜头贴近银河平面时会看到粗糙像素，因此在本模组中做了改进。主要改动包括将 4K 银河图调整到 8K，在放大时提供更多细节，并重制了恒星贴图、缩小每颗恒星并提升整体分辨率。作者说明会锁定银河尺寸，可能与其他改动银河尺寸的模组不兼容，另提供蓝色调版本。

Version 1.3.28 for Stellaris 4.2.x "Corvus".

https://i.imgur.com/fVVaDCS.gif

https://i.imgur.com/z1zAxc8.png

This is a mod sort of complimentary to either Kepler68's [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=822305739]More Star classes, or Annatar's [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=937289339]Real Space, that adds several new types of stars that as of now are only hypothetical and have not been detected yet.

https://i.imgur.com/z1zAxc8.png

Features:


    [*]7 new types of stars (some included in binary systems):
    
		[*]Antimatter star
        [*]Blue dwarf star
		[*]Black dwarf star
		[*]Dark star
		[*]Quasi-star
        [*]Strange star
        [*]White hole
    
	[*]6 new modifiers:
	
		[*]Q-star (for black holes)
		[*]Intermediate mass black hole (for black holes)
		[*]Population III star (for class M and K stars)
		[*]Thorne-Żytkow object (for red supergiants and hypergiants)
		[*]Quark Star (for neutron stars and pulsars)
		[*]Electroweak star (for neutron stars and pulsars that have the Quark Star modifier)
	
    [*]3 new strategic resources, with their corresponding technologies:
	
		[*]Strange matter, found in strange stars.
		[*]Quark-gluon plasma, found in quark stars.
		[*]Antimatter, found in antimatter stars.
        
    [*]3 new edicts that make use of the new strategic resources.
	
		[*]Strange matter alloys research: costs 50 strange matter, gives +25% materials research, +25% ship armour.
		[*]Antimatter explosives research: costs 25 antimatter, gives +25% propulsion research, +25% explosive weapons damage.
		[*]Quantum physics research: costs 25 quark-gluon plasma, gives +25% physics research.
	
[*]English, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, German, Russian and Polish localisation. Japanese localisation patch [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2875155125]here.


https://i.imgur.com/z1zAxc8.png

Compatibility

This mod should be compatible with most mods, since it doesn't overwrite any vanilla file. However, there are some mods that are known to cause issues:

	[*]Any mod that adds strategic resources - You'll need to also enable the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1595876588]Universal Resource Patch, so all of the resources are shown properly.
	[*]Stellar Energy - [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=914348460&searchtext=]Compatibility patch by Zinogre here!
	[*]Real Space - Compatibility patch no longer needed.
	[*]Enigmatic Technologies - Might cause some graphical bugs.
	[*]Gigastructures - Compatibility fixed. Now both mods should work together well.
    [*]Unique Ascension Perks - Has separate white hole and antimatter so they show in duplicate. May make compatibility patch in the future.


This mod should also be compatible with beautification mod [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2106506823]! 00 Infinite Graphic I - Gorgeous Galaxy, although I cannot assure it since I haven't tested it.

If you find any bugs or problems, please let me know in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/910751973/1318835718938242956/]bug reports section :)

https://i.imgur.com/z1zAxc8.png

    [*]Blitzars with special anomalies to observe their collapse.
    [*]Enviromental effects
    [*]Iron Stars
    [*]Frozen Stars
	[*]Special naming system for White Holes, analogously to black holes.
	[*]Starting systems with the hypothetical stars.


https://i.imgur.com/z1zAxc8.png

translations.description_clean:
Stellaris. The final frontier...

Introducing my own Star Trek themed shipset, with over 50 custom models and textures depicting ships from Star Trek!

Star Trek has had a long history of kitbashing: creating new ships designs by reusing older models and rearranging the parts. Each ship class, with the exception of the corvette, frigates and juggernaut, has been split into sections just like vanilla shipsets. This allows you to mix-and-match parts to make your own designs!

Destroyers are split into Saucer and Nacelles, while Cruisers, Battleships and Titans are divided by Saucer, Hull and Nacelles.

As well as the ships, this shipset adds new Station models. Eventually I plan to update this mod to include Megastructures.

This Mod adds the following models:

Civilian:
• Runabout (Construction)

• Conestoga (Colony)

• Type-6 Shuttle (Fighter)

Space Stations:

• 附带模型：恒星基地（5 阶）、居住站（3 阶）、深空星垒（3 阶）、民用站、防御平台/离子炮、城市星球、超空间中继皮肤，以及面向 Gigastructures 的巨型船坞、轨道环、轨道方舟与小行星工业综合体皮肤。
• 推荐搭配：星战武器与舰船组件；星战起始星系与肖像包；Fleet Formation Mod v2（改善原版糟糕的舰船间距）。

Exact machine traits are slightly better to make game more balanced. 

Supported languages are English, German, French, Spanish and Russian. Please contact me if you can translate to another language supported by the game.

Please let me know if you want some area covered by a new trait ([url=http://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/850721710/133255603283620435]discussion link). You can let me know your comments regarding balance here: [url=http://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/850721710/133255603283907378]discussion link.

List of traits: [url=http://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/850721710/133256080237597433] link to discussion.

 Change log:
V 1.0: 24 traits added.
V1.1: 10 new traits were added: slaver, grunt, loyalist, rebel, scavenger, hive, clone, advanced engineer, advanced sociologist and advanced physicist. Trait robot tuned.
V1.2: 11 new traits added: small creature, big creature, wanderer, hedonist, extreme harvester, super efficient, survivalist, obnoxious, replicator, prey and unreliable.
V1.3: 13 new traits added: ancient, parasite host, criminal, lawful, exterminator, invasive, fanatical, self-sufficient, mercenary, servant, mineral consumer, food consumer and energy consumer.
V1.4: several traits were revised to be more diverse and balanced.
V1.5: updates implemented for 1.5 Banks, ethics attraction and consuming of goods modifiers have been added to traits, happiness modifiers to other species updated according to vanilla game. Hive mind ethics considered when traits are selected. New traits individualist, collectivist and psi-gifted have been added.
V1.6: 4 new unity traits added: united, extremely united, divided, extremely divided. Previous traits also received modifiers regarding unity and food output when they are consumed.
V1.7: 7 new machine traits added:  super efficient processors, inefficient processors, super inefficient processors, extreme mass produced, extreme custom made, completely recycled, super luxurious.

 Trait Hive  
The mod has trait Hive which was created before Utopia :). Also it allows highly unified play style without negative/positive features of Hive-mind and it is an option for players who do not have Utopia.

2.0+ Update Note: there may still be bugs with this mod due to the massive changes in the latest update, please report any bugs to the bug discussion thread.

Credits for everything in Leviathan Events Xtended but the port to 2.1 goes to: Forum user Bitterbaum, and the Skidbladnir model was made for the More Events Mod, so credit for the ownership of that model goes to that team.
The only thing i did was add a few tweaks to the mod to make it playable in 2.1 until the orignal author of LEX (Bitterbaum) finishes his changes in his rewrite of the mod.

Note: I did balance this mod with Titans and New Ship Classes and More in mind, so a vanilla player with neither of those might have a harder time dealing with the guardians in this mod.

Here is the original forum posting of LEX if anyone is interested: https://forum.paradoxplaza.com/forum/index.php?threads/mod-lex-leviathan-events-xtended.979826/

NOTE: This is a standalone mod, as the original has been taken down for the duration of the rewrite. This mod also does not overwrite original game files, but some mods that overwrite original game files may cause issues with this mod due to the nature of their changes.

Original Description of the mod:
LEX - Leviathan Events Xtended
is a series of events designed to introduce more large, dangerous and highly rewarding events into the game to allow the player to immerse themselves into the Stellaris universe. The mod contains many custom assets and textures to expand the base games content.

1. These events are designed as late-game content. They are designed to be challenging, but there are means within the mod to give the player an advantage if they can find them.

2. A new savegame is NOT required to access the content, as long as the save file doesn't contain any data from a previous iteration of LEX. In that case there is a high chance of savegame corruption.

3. Compatability with other mods hasn't been extensively tested. And when encountering errors/bugs we ask the players to bear this in mind. As long as a mod doesnt modify vanilla components it should be okay.

Available Content:

<> Throne Watchers - An abandoned ringworld, guarded by the creations of its former owners.

<> The Gravekeeper - A derelict spacestation in the midst of an ancient battlefield.

<> The Garden - A beautiful shielded garden world surrounded by relics of a bygone age.

<> The Threshold - A forgotten research station in a system covered in an impenetrable fog.

<> Crossing the Rubicon - Hubris of a long forgotten past.

<> Abyss Dwellers - Coming Soon

translations.description_clean:
SpeedDial


SpeedDial adds buttons at the top left of your screen once you establish communications with enclaves. The buttons act as a 'speed dial', allowing you to open a diplomacy window with them direct from the main screen without having to navigate to different menus. You can contact the Artisans, Curators, Traders, Marauders, Caravaneers, and the Shroud using these buttons.

Once you discover a trader or curator enclave, an 'extend' button will appear which will let you call a specific enclave. You can then switch the mode to 'fixed' to contact the last enclave you contacted using the extended buttons.

The hover-over tooltip for the Shroud now displays approximate waiting times! The tooltip changes to show if you have to wait less than:

10/5/4/3/2/1 years, and 6/5/4/3/2/1 months


**IMPORTANT**

If you activate the mod in an old save file, be aware of two things:

Specific Curator calling will be enabled at the end of the first month you play.

The Shroud timer tooltips will be broken if you are currently still in cooldown (ie. you reached into the Shroud before you saved the game, and before you installed/updated this mod). You will get a popup in-game explaining this. To fix the tooltips, wait till you can reach into the shroud again, then let a month tick by.


Other Versions

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/zraith]zraith's [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=827831523]Additional Map Modes compatible version [2.1]: [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=909785520]here.

SpeedDial for 3.1.*: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3041809242]here (this was "live" version up to patch 3.9.1)
 
Mods with Integrated Support

2023-09-26 NOTE: At some point in the past these mods were integrated and supported. It is unknown to what extent they still compatible:

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/folk_]folk's [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=821458136]Mercenary Enclave

(the following based on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/908639878/3581993633019335699/]relytor's code)
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198010522523]XVCV's [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1762062219]Unofficial Machine and Synthetic Empire DLC
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198058943486]Complex's [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1715190550]Unofficial Hive DLC: Forgotten Queens
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/Klarac]Klaric's [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1902736901]Psionic Hive Minds

(the following based on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/GreenKeldeo]GreenKeldeo's code)
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/the24thds]the24thds's [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=2356224372]New Enclaves 
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/GreenKeldeo]GreenKeldeo et al's [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2491048938]Xenonion News Enclave

Compatibility

This mod should be compatible with all mods which don't modify certain parts of the GUI, such as mapmodes.

If you're using [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=2010312291]Event Horizon Offset Facility, make sure to also use the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=2009582159]compatibility patch

Localisation

Localisation is English for all languages by default. If you want your own language supported, provide localisation and I'll include it and recognize you here. I've added more to this mod, so further localisation is necessary (Although I've added some localisation lines on occasion).

[✓] Polish by [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/alienquake]AL|EN
[✓] Russian by [url=http://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198142757164]Isterichka, [url=http://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198051778636/]had and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198080401755/]Dimuch62 , updated by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198155578056]SmokeAnDrink

[~] French by EwieFairy and [url=http://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198004549521]Khyinn
[✓] Spanish by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198155578056]SmokeAnDrink
 Portuguese

[✓] = up to date
[~] = not up to date

Thanks to the localisation contributors!

F.A.Q.s

• Can I get achievements if I use this mod?

No. The fact that custom buttons exist in a mod makes achievements unavailable - nothing I can do about that.

• What if there are x trader or curator enclaves? What do the buttons do then?

The trader and curator buttons call a random known trader or curator. Or you can call specific ones using the 'extended' mode

• I want to call a specific trader!

You can switch your mode to 'extended', and call a trader that way. Switching the mode to 'fixed' will change the main buttons to call the last enclave called using the extended lists!

Notes for Modders

Note for mod compatibility:

This should be compatible with most mods, but may not be compatible with some map mods. If it's not compatible, you'll need to merge the mods in question. See below.

Note for modders:

This mod replaces "maingui_bottombar" inside main_bottom.gui. Four 'effectButtonType' containers are added near the top of the gui file. If your mod edits this file, you'll need to merge both mods and copy over the relevant containers to your new gui file.

🛠️ Added the missing conditions and weights for Custodian-related resolution to AI Will in Galactic Community.(Paradox just forgot it.)

🛠️ The AI country with Civic Autonomous Drones or Sovereign Circuits will now normally recruit leaders instead of being in a daze.(In vanilla, they still don't understand how to use Energy, Food or Minerals for a leaders' upkeep.)
